# 上玄高真延壽赤書

**ID:** KR5c0275
**Custom ID:** ZB5c0266

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Red Book for Prolonging Life, from the Most High Mystery and Lofty Perfected*

compiled by [裴鉉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A3%B4%E9%89%89) (Péi Xuàn) — Táng Zhōngnánshān Daoist

The **scripture proper** accompanying Péi Xuàn's memorial (see [KR5c0274](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0274)) — a Táng collection of **longevity and visualization techniques** gathered from the "high perfected" (*gāo zhēn* 高真), centring on the visualization of sun/moon pairs (*yù yí* 鬱儀 and *jié lín* 結璘) in the eyes, and the heart-sun visualization of the Southern Ultimate Dame (*Nán jí fū rén* 南極夫人). Preserved as **DZ 877b** / CT 877b (*Dòngshén bù, Fāngfǎ lèi* 洞神部方法類).

**Dating.** Táng. Dynasty: 唐.
